_comment: Mode roster read off the in-game Custom Search screen, captured 2026-08-05 (Steam capture 20260805170513). That screen names every mode in its list but describes only the highlighted one, so the description here is TBD until the tile is opened and read. A named-but-undescribed mode is recorded rather than omitted, same rule as the vehicle option tiles: dropping it would read as 'this mode does not exist'.
name: Obliteration
_alias_note: The "obliteration" alias also matches Tactical Obliteration, which is a separate mode added in 1.3.3.0. Check the tag before accepting an auto-tagged line.
_tag_deny_note: Tactical Obliteration is a separate mode added in 1.3.3.0. A line naming only that one must not land here; a line naming both still matches on the bare name.
